SUPPLIER OPERATIONS
Industry context · Taiwan / Shanghai
From lot records to the next operating decision

For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, progress and quality information becomes useful when the source, scope and decision owner are clear.

Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.

01
Where to start

Start with one handoff

Choose one production lot and the planning decision that needs its progress or quality status. Identify the source record, when it was updated, and what it covers.

Agree who checks a mismatch, who receives the confirmed information and what evidence they need before the next step.

02
Roles and responsibilities

Keep planning and production evidence in their roles

ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.

Map the information each team needs before defining the solution scope and data handoff.

03
Industry context

Semiconductor industry context: Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技, Taiwan / Shanghai, produces silicon wafer materials. The case covers crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.

Digiwin describes production genealogy from silicon crystals to wafer lots, visibility into production progress and equipment status, and epitaxy history with quality parameter limits.

For an equipment-component supplier, these are useful questions about traceability and execution visibility to bring into its own process discussion.

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

TALK WITH DIGIWIN VIETNAM

Define the fit with the team in Vietnam

Digiwin Vietnam specialists assess factory operations, advise on business processes and support on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.

Bring a current production-to-planning handoff to the discussion: its records, the people involved, the receiving decision and the gaps to resolve. This helps define the processes and implementation scope for your factory.

PACKAGING & TESTING
Reference case · China
A shared starting point for quality review

An unexpected test result calls for a clear starting point: the lot, the production context and the person who checks the record next. Explore how a named packaging and testing business connects production records with Digiwin ERP + iMES.

Digiwin’s visit to 江苏中科智芯集成科技有限公司 · September 2020.
Source: 鼎捷智造___new on Sohu · original photo contains Chinese text

01
The business context

Records and processes need to work together

According to the case published by Digiwin Vietnam, 江苏中科智芯集成科技有限公司 in China implemented an integrated ERP + iMES solution. The published problems include disorganized records, nonstandard processes and low outsourcing and production efficiency.

ERP + iMES
江苏中科智芯集成科技有限公司

02
Inside the case

How the implementation connects information

The published mechanisms span shopfloor data, production records, parameter changes and exception handling within the integrated solution.

Shopfloor information · SPC

SPC (statistical process control) collects and analyzes shopfloor information in real time.

Parameter changes · ECN

ECN (engineering change notice) distributes process parameter changes in real time.

Linked records

MES links batches, workstations, operators and products/materials for tracing from different perspectives.

Exception recording & escalation

The system automatically opens exception records and escalates them through successive levels.

03
Review your current setup

Give Quality and Operations a shared basis for the next check

Use the case as a reference for these questions about your own review workflow.

Start from the same lot and context

When a result needs review, can both teams locate the lot, test time and related production record?

INFORMATION TO PREPARE
Prepare one example of a lot record and how it reaches the review team.

Make the next check and owner clear

Who confirms the information source, checks missing records and follows up an exception?

INFORMATION TO PREPARE
Prepare your current handoff steps and the roles responsible for each check.

Keep changes visible during review

Where do teams find the applicable parameter revision and the record of an exception?

INFORMATION TO PREPARE
Prepare one parameter-change record and an example of exception follow-up.

A clear view of records and responsibilities can help your teams identify where coordination needs attention. Start the discussion with one actual review workflow at your company.

TALK WITH DIGIWIN VIETNAM

Bring one quality-review workflow to the discussion

Describe how Quality and Operations share lot records, confirm changes and assign the next check. We provide digital solutions for manufacturing, from ERP to smart manufacturing.

The next step opens Digiwin Vietnam’s consultation request page in Vietnamese.

Discuss records and review ownership
Reference source
Read the Chinese case collection

In the source, select 封装测试, then 案例 06 江苏中科智芯集成科技有限公司.

Source: Simplified Chinese · this page summarizes the named case.

visibleText:

製造業數位化方案
Tiếng Việt
English
简体中文
繁體中文
供應商系統
產業脈絡 · 台灣 / 上海
系統交接前，先釐清紀錄歸屬

半導體設備零組件供應商的工廠 IT 與營運團隊，需要共同釐清紀錄定義、維護責任及接收方決策。

本頁專用示意圖：矽晶體、晶圓、磊晶與生產紀錄。並非Wafer Works或其設備的照片。

01
從何開始

從一筆生產紀錄開始

選定排程或品質團隊需要的一筆紀錄，釐清其定義、更新時間及生產範圍。

確認由哪個團隊與系統維護、誰核對差異，以及誰確認交接。

02
角色與權責

區分企業與生產的責任

ERP 支援企業訂單、物料、規劃與成本管理。製造執行解決方案支援生產進度、批次紀錄及品質資訊。

用這些角色梳理紀錄責任與流程需求。先與工廠團隊界定技術範圍，再選擇資訊交接方式。

03
產業脈絡

產業脈絡：Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技在台灣 / 上海生產矽晶圓材料，涵蓋晶體生長、晶圓加工及磊晶。

案例將矽晶體連結到各晶圓批次的生產履歷，並呈現進度、設備狀態及設有品質參數限值的磊晶紀錄。

工廠團隊可據此釐清自身流程討論需要關注的生產紀錄及責任。

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

與DIGIWIN越南交流

與越南團隊界定本廠範圍

Digiwin 越南團隊評估工廠營運、提供業務流程建議，並支援現場方案移交及工廠驗收。

帶上一項現有資訊交接、紀錄維護方、接收方決策及待核對差異，共同梳理流程與實施範圍。

參考來源

Define record ownership before a system handoff

For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, factory IT and operating teams need shared definitions, record responsibility and clear receiving decisions.

Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.

01
Where to start

Start with one production record

Choose one record that planning or quality teams need. Identify its meaning, update timing and production scope.

Record which team and system maintains it, who checks differences and who confirms the handoff.

02
Roles and responsibilities

Separate enterprise and production responsibilities

ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.

Use these roles to discuss record responsibility and process needs. Define the technical scope with the factory teams before selecting a handoff approach.

03
Industry context

Industry context: Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技 in Taiwan / Shanghai produces silicon wafer materials through crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.

The case connects silicon crystals to wafer-lot production history and provides visibility into progress, equipment status and epitaxy records with quality parameter limits.

These production-information topics help factory teams identify the records and responsibilities to discuss in their own processes.

Industry context · Taiwan / Shanghai
From lot records to the next operating decision

For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, progress and quality information becomes useful when the source, scope and decision owner are clear.

Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.

01
Where to start

Start with one handoff

Choose one production lot and the planning decision that needs its progress or quality status. Identify the source record, when it was updated, and what it covers.

Agree who checks a mismatch, who receives the confirmed information and what evidence they need before the next step.

02
Roles and responsibilities

Keep planning and production evidence in their roles

ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.

Map the information each team needs before defining the solution scope and data handoff.

03
Industry context

Semiconductor industry context: Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技, Taiwan / Shanghai, produces silicon wafer materials. The case covers crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.

Digiwin describes production genealogy from silicon crystals to wafer lots, visibility into production progress and equipment status, and epitaxy history with quality parameter limits.

For an equipment-component supplier, these are useful questions about traceability and execution visibility to bring into its own process discussion.

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

TALK WITH DIGIWIN VIETNAM

Define the fit with the team in Vietnam

Digiwin Vietnam specialists assess factory operations, advise on business processes and support on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.

Bring a current production-to-planning handoff to the discussion: its records, the people involved, the receiving decision and the gaps to resolve. This helps define the processes and implementation scope for your factory.
